image_description: An open, bi-fold restaurant menu lying flat on a surface. The left page features two circular images of food dishes (likely salads or appetizers) with accompanying text lists and prices in red ink. The right page contains a dense list of text items with prices, organized in columns, also in red ink. The background is white paper. The text appears to be Chinese characters mixed with numbers.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While there is text, the 'headings' are not clearly distinct from the body text in terms of font weight or size hierarchy. The text consistency is questionable due to AI artifacts (see below).

artifact_observations.location: Throughout the text areas on both pages
artifact_observations.reasoning: The characters resemble Chinese script but are structurally nonsensical and malformed. They do not form valid words. This is a classic AI generation artifact where the model mimics the texture of text without understanding the semantics or orthography.

artifact_observations.location: Food images on the left page
artifact_observations.reasoning: The food images have a slightly 'painted' or overly smooth texture compared to realistic photography. The boundaries between the food and the plate/background are slightly soft/bleeding.

artifact_observations.location: Right edge of the right page
artifact_observations.reasoning: The curvature of the page near the spine is plausible, but the outer edge seems to warp slightly inconsistently with the lighting/shadows.
